howToRead: As counting-hills.arc.json. More move words for the players still to come: balance `block` (that many blocks put on the light pan in one run) or `put` (the named thing put on a `pan`); build_pattern `cell` and `piece` (a card laid on that place, from the start dot); clock_set `hand` and `to` (the hand turned to that hour); shop_pay `coin` (one coin of that kind on the counter).
A deal shown in turn (MATH-A-03, B-10) is a sort whose cards have their bins in turn: it plays on the sort player of today.
